ns2:section.sectionText: This Graduate section meets with ACE 398 Sections CR & NT as well as RST 199 Sections CR & NT. Provides participants an in-depth, experiential immersion into the complex issues and constraints that confront international marketing channel participants. Contextually grounded and themed in a specific industry, the course combines on-campus lectures with an intensive international immersion experience to Europe, Asia, or Latin America. By following the complete marketing channel from raw materials procurement to final consumption, participants gain first-hand knowledge of the necessary managerial decision-making skills required to successfully operate in today's global business environment. This section is for Graduate students who will be traveling to Croatia. Email csandle2@illinois.edu for an override to register.
